pages.text: The Wither and Ender Dragon drop a stable Division Sigil when mob loot is enabled. The sigil returns from crafting with one point of wear and has 256 uses. It is already active.

pages.title: Unstable Metal
pages.text: This port’s Unstable Ingots and Nuggets are stable crafting materials. The ingot recipe takes iron, while the nugget recipe takes a gold nugget. Both use a diamond and the sigil.$(br2)Use the ingots in equipment recipes.
